title: 美国电网新增电力：九成来自新能源，美银豪掷2500亿够用吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So this is kind of a three-pronged deal here, digital infrastructure, energy and power, core infrastructure.
segments.zh: 这是一项三管齐下的交易，涉及数字基础设施、能源电力和核心基础设施。

segments.en: So our digital infrastructure data centers, we all know that.
segments.zh: 数字基础设施和数据中心，我们都了解。

segments.en: Everyone's talking about the power side of this.
segments.zh: 大家都在讨论电力方面的需求。

segments.en: And what is needed to actually fund that?
segments.zh: 实际需要多少资金来支持？

segments.en: And more importantly, how far along are we? Well, I think we need trillions of dollars for nation's critical infrastructure development, which is why we're so excited to be announcing this today.
segments.zh: 更重要的是，我们进展如何？我认为国家关键基础设施建设需要数万亿美元，这也是我们今天宣布这一消息的原因。

segments.en: And we do believe infrastructure investment is a unifying national priority that can actually produce economic growth and jobs and community development
segments.zh: 我们相信基础设施**是一个全国性的优先事项，能够促进经济增长、就业和社区发展。

segments.en: and long-term competitiveness. To answer your question on power and power development in particular, that is the number one constraint right now for compute power, i.e.
segments.zh: 以及长期竞争力。关于电力发展，目前这是计算能力的主要制约因素。

segments.en: the digital infrastructure side. Clearly, we have to build the data centers, we have to build up the equipment for the data centers and obviously supply the chips.
segments.zh: 显然，我们必须建设数据中心，配备设备，并提供芯片。

segments.en: However, without power, there is no compute power. So on the power side, interestingly, you mentioned renewable energy and storage.
segments.zh: 然而，没有电力，就没有计算能力。在电力方面，你提到了可再生能源和储能。

segments.en: That is pretty cheap to construct and then pretty fast to construct.
segments.zh: 这些建设成本低，速度快。

segments.en: So in fact, we actually have seen 90% of the new electrons added to the United States power grid being renewable energy and storage.
segments.zh: 事实上，美国电网新增的电力中，90%来自可再生能源和储能。

segments.en: And we need gas power, too. Obviously, the turbines and lead times, you guys have all reported on that.
segments.zh: 我们也需要天然气发电。显然，涡轮机和交付周期，你们都有报道。

segments.en: And we need longer term, clean 24-7 firm power, as well, such as nuclear or advanced geothermal.
segments.zh: 长期来看，我们还需要清洁的24/7稳定电力，比如核能或先进地热。

segments.en: It has to be all of the above. So I know the 250th obviously, that number kind of picked a peg to the anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence 250 years ago.
segments.zh: 所以必须全面发展。我知道250这个数字，恰好对应《独立宣言》签署250周年。
